Risk_Description: Native Windows PETSc Compilation and MPI Barrier
Impact_on_Physical_Modeling: Inability to execute globally coupled distributed 2D SSA solves on native Windows workstation
Mitigation_Strategy_and_Action: Mandate deployment via WSL2 (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with apt petsc-dev and petsc4py) OR Conda-forge environment; use Scipy sparse iterative solver as interim Level B verification backup

Risk_Description: Offline Sandbox Network Isolation During Data Ingestion
Impact_on_Physical_Modeling: Automated download of ITS_LIVE, MEaSUREs, and RACMO blocked in standard sandbox mode
Mitigation_Strategy_and_Action: Execute downloads with explicit user bypass authorization OR provision pre-downloaded tarballs into data/raw/ directly

Risk_Description: Velocity Data Gaps in Narrow Upper Tributaries
Impact_on_Physical_Modeling: 6.3% missing data in ITS_LIVE along narrow Palmer Land nunataks and cloud-covered slopes
Mitigation_Strategy_and_Action: Apply inverse-variance optimal interpolation combining ITS_LIVE and MEaSUREs; DO NOT fill with zero velocity; flag uncertain cells

Risk_Description: BedMachine Floating Shelf Calving Front Temporal Drift
Impact_on_Physical_Modeling: BedMachine v4.1 mask=3 reflects 2019 shelf geometry; major rifting (e.g. Larsen C A68 iceberg) altered calving front
Mitigation_Strategy_and_Action: Incorporate multi-epoch satellite calving front vectors (MEaSUREs / Baumhoer 2021) to mask detached icebergs in prognostic runs

Risk_Description: Memory Exhaustion During Global Jacobian Assembly
Impact_on_Physical_Modeling: Host workstation has 3.3 GB currently available RAM; uncompressed 1.73M DOF Jacobian + ILU fill-in may trigger page swapping
Mitigation_Strategy_and_Action: Enforce memory-efficient CSR matrix allocation (MATAIJ), eliminate high-order fill-in, and close unneeded host background applications
